name: Tofu Kadai
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp grated ginger
1 tsp coriander seeds and 2 dried red chillies, coarsely crushed
steps: Pat the tofu dry and pan-sear in a non-stick pan with half the oil for 6 minutes until golden on the sides. Set aside.
Heat the remaining oil, crackle the cumin, then add the crushed coriander seeds and chillies.
Add ginger, garlic and tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the onion and capsicum and cook for 4 minutes, keeping them slightly crisp.
Return the tofu, add garam masala and salt, and toss for 2 minutes. Finish with coriander.
note: Freshly crushed coriander seeds and dried chilli give kadai masala its character.
